literal: Difficult things, saying [thus], impossible there is not, if one does, guarding with the unforgetting instrument.
translation: There is nothing that is impossible, dismissed as too difficult, if one performs actions with care, using the instrument of unforgetfulness.
modern: மறதி இல்லாத மனமாகிய கருவியைக் கொண்டு, எச்சரிக்கையுடன் ஒரு செயலைச் செய்தால், 'இது செய்வதற்கு அரியது' என்று முடியாத காரியம் எதுவும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the power of constant vigilance and mindfulness in achieving any goal. The poet states that no task is impossible or too difficult to accomplish if it is undertaken with an unforgetting mind (பொச்சாவாக் கருவி) and guarded care (போற்றி). The 'unforgetting instrument' refers to a mind that is always alert, focused, and free from negligence. By maintaining this state of active awareness, even the most challenging obstacles can be overcome, leaving nothing as truly impossible.
